howto.what: 安装后，Claude 在处理聊天流时，会使用统一的 element_bid 作为渲染键，兼容旧字段，并确保历史记录与实时 SSE 数据产生一致的 contentList。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude will use a unified element_bid as the rendering key for chat items, keep backward-compatible fields, and ensure that historical records and real-time SSE data produce a consistent contentList.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the ai-shifu chat stream evolves from block granularity to element granularity, or when there are consistency issues between history records and SSE rendering.

say_en.note: Claude will overwrite by element_bid without duplicate concatenation.
